fields.notes: Block guide does not specify confidentiality / integrity / authentication requirements for the serial peripheral. Any access-control (e.g. privileged-mode register access) is deferred to SoC integration.
fields.mode: CCM* (Counter with CBC-MAC, star variant — allows encryption-only / integrity-only)

keys.name: Network key
keys.desc: shared by all devices; secures NWK frames; distributed by the Trust Center; supports rotation (key sequence number).

keys.name: Link key
keys.desc: pairwise APS-layer key (trust-center link key or application link key) for end-to-end security.

fields.trust_center: A single device (normally the Zigbee Coordinator) that authenticates joining devices and distributes the network key; manages key establishment.
fields.install_code: Per-device pre-configured secret used to derive a unique trust-center link key during Zigbee 3.0 commissioning.

extraction_hints: Look for key-management, side-channel, secure-boot sections.
